candidates.statement: Gateway /v1/checkout returns 502 because its downstream call to order POST /v1/orders returns HTTP 500; the order service is the failing dependency, not the gateway itself.
candidates.uncertainty: Order-side logs/metrics are absent, so the internal cause of the order 500 (db pool, redis, payment) is not established; only the failing hop is bounded.

report.explanation: Traces and logs show every checkout 502 is paired with a downstream order POST /v1/orders returning 500, with short durations (~15-60ms) ruling out latency. Gateway /readyz and /healthz are healthy. The bounded fault is the order dependency returning 500; the specific internal cause requires order-side evidence.
missing_evidence: Order service logs/traces for POST /v1/orders to identify the internal error behind the 500
Order service metrics (db pool, redis, payment dependency latency/errors) to rule out db-pool-exhaustion, redis-timeout, downstream-latency
